HOW TO PLAY

  1. Check the model on the left. On phones, it's up top.
  2. Pick a color, then tap the board to place blocks. Tap a block again to remove it.
  3. Match the model, then hit Done!
  4. On Hard, you get 10 seconds to memorize the model before it hides. Peek up to 3 times if you get stuck.
  5. Build fast and use fewer hints to earn 3 stars. Best times and badges are saved on this device.
